ValidationRule.description: To close a case that has Classification field as "Incidencia" must have the following fields completed: SIRO Account, Amount finally assumed (EUR), Operational risk (EUR), Accounting date, Trader/Sales
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( !$Setup.CIB_Bypass__c.CIB_skip_validationrule__c, !$Setup.CIB_User_Org__c.CIB_Is_Admin__c, $Setup.CIB_User_Org__c.CIB_Is_Service__c, ISPICKVAL(SER_Business_Case_Type__c, "GM"), ISPICKVAL( SER_Classification__c , "Incidencia"), NOT(ISBLANK(SER_SLA_Service__c)), OR( ISPICKVAL(Status,"Closed"), SER_Close__c = True ), OR( ISBLANK(TEXT(SER_SIRO_Account__c )), ISBLANK(SER_Amount_finally_assumed_EUR__c ), ISBLANK(SER_Operational_risk_EUR__c ), ISBLANK(SER_Accounting_date__c ), ISBLANK(SER_Trader_Sales__c ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Claim cases must have SIRO Account, Amount finally assumed (EUR), Operational risk (EUR), Accounting date, Trader/Sales fields completed before closing them.
